reserveReview.rationale: Independently recomputed under owner ruling D01 from the complete first-party 2026-10-27T16:03:47.000Z balance sheet (Ethereum block 26285121): every asset amount is disclosed in USD and divided by totalAssets USD 102118411.3803. WTGXX's two disclosed holdings (USD 14597867.90 redemption contract + USD 52889724.20 BitGo Trust Account) are aggregated; six resulting weights are rounded independently to eight decimal places and sum to 100 with no invented residual. USDB (Bridge) is no longer listed by the source and its prior 0.00000353% slice is removed, not zero-filled. Existing asset-class and liquidity mappings are preserved; AUSD and USDC identities match the exact Ethereum tokens disclosed by the source.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Frax frxUSD balance-sheet asset values normalized by the live frax-balance-sheet adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every disclosed balance-sheet asset is represented, including AUSD and USDC. The arithmetic refresh does not establish portfolio-wide legal custody safeguards or stressed cash-out bounds; existing mappings are not upgraded.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: wtgxx-wisdomtree is a quarantined no-supply record (permitted runtime sources report no positive circulating supply or market cap) that can never carry a live score, so this slice is scored on its own fund-share asset class rather than linked as a dependency edge.
EREBOR_USD is an issuer-identified FBO bank-deposit account holding frxUSD reserve cash, not a holding of the tracked frxUSD token and therefore not a dependency edge.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's balance sheet identifies WTGXX held in Frax Inc's BitGo Trust Account and cash in a segregated Erebor Bank FBO frxUSD Stablecoin Reserve Account. Other balances are held in on-chain redemption contracts or a Solana multisig, with underlying fund and stablecoin custody outside those contracts. Provider percentages, the BitGo legal entity and account safeguards, portfolio-wide segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation restrictions are not established by these sources. Source-scoped correction (2026-10-20): withdraw institutional-top and use mixed for the evidenced heterogeneous custody chain. Named partial custodians do not establish a whole-book institutional tier. Preserve original October1 review and composition dates, reserve weights, historical provider identities and all unknown safeguards.
